name: handler_pbcol
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported as an ANSI Background Color in the Terminal

origin.description: Report progress as one terminal line colored from the left as the ratio advances.
origin.usage: handler_pbcol(adjust = 0, pad = 1L, complete = function(s) cli::bg_blue(cli::col_white(s)), incomplete = function(s) cli::bg_cyan(cli::col_white(s)), intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.terminal", 1), target = "terminal", ...)

arguments.name: adjust
arguments.text: Where the message sits. 0 is the left and 1 is the right.

arguments.name: pad
arguments.text: Spaces on each side of the message.

arguments.name: complete
arguments.text: Styles the finished part of the line. The default is bg_blue of col_white.

arguments.name: incomplete
arguments.text: Styles the remaining part of the line. The default is bg_cyan of col_white.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.terminal, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".

origin.details: Each update redraws the line with a carriage return. clear TRUE erases it. clear FALSE redraws the finished line and writes a newline so the last line remains. A spinner steps through -, backslash, |, and /.
origin.example:
h <- handler_pbcol(clear = FALSE, enable = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("handler_pbcol clear is %s and target is %s.\n", environment(h)$clear, environment(h)$target))

translation.description: Report progress as one terminal line colored from the left as the ratio advances.
translation.usage: handler_pbcol(adjust=0.0, pad=1, complete=bg_blue(col_white(s)), incomplete=bg_cyan(col_white(s)), intrusiveness=None, target="terminal", **extra)

arguments.name: adjust
arguments.text: Where the message sits. 0 is the left and 1 is the right.

arguments.name: pad
arguments.text: Spaces on each side of the message.

arguments.name: complete
arguments.text: Styles the finished part of the line. The default calls bg_blue and col_white.

arguments.name: incomplete
arguments.text: Styles the remaining part of the line. The default calls bg_cyan and col_white.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.terminal, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".

translation.details: Each update redraws the line with a carriage return. clear TRUE erases it. clear FALSE redraws the finished line and writes a newline so the last line remains. With one ANSI color the styled parts are the plain text.
translation.value: A calling handler whose first class is pbcol_progression_handler.
translation.example:
from progressr.cli_handlers import handler_pbcol

handler = handler_pbcol(clear=False, enable=True)
clear = "TRUE" if handler._env["clear"] else "FALSE"
print(f"handler_pbcol clear is {clear} and target is {handler._env['target']}.")
